name: MJS Websites
summary: MJS Websites designs and builds WordPress websites for UK small businesses, charities and organisations, and hosts and looks after them. It is part of MJS Media Ltd (company number 09511530), based in Bexhill-on-Sea, East Sussex, which has built over 100 websites in more than 10 years. AI speeds up the repetitive parts of each build, with a person designing, checking and testing every site, and we aim to launch within a week of receiving your content. Website refresh from £495, new websites from £995, or rent a website for £75 a month. Prices exclude VAT.

services.name: Website Refresh
services.description: Rebuild an existing website from its usable pages, words and images with a modern design. Up to six pages, from £495 one-off, plus hosting and care at £25 a month.

services.name: New Website to Own
services.description: A new WordPress website built around your business: structure, design and up to six pages, from £995 one-off, plus hosting and care at £25 a month.

services.name: Website Rental
services.description: A new website, hosting and care for £75 a month with a £149 setup fee and a 24-month minimum term. New websites only; you can buy it for £495 after 24 months.

services.name: WordPress hosting and care
services.description: Hosting with SSL, daily backups, security patches, WordPress updates, uptime monitoring and support for £25 a month, no minimum term, with a free move from your current host.

services.name: Advanced WordPress hosting

faqs.a: A refresh suits an existing site with usable pages and content that needs a better layout and modern design. A new website suits a new business or a site that needs a new structure and substantial new pages. We’ll confirm which applies before quoting.
No. Website Rental is for new websites only. A Website Refresh is a one-off payment from £495, with hosting and care at £25/month.

If you pay upfront, the website is yours once the build is paid in full. A rented website stays ours unless you buy it for £495 after 24 months. Your domain and the content you supply are always yours.

faqs.q: When does billing start on a rental?
faqs.a: The £149 setup fee and first monthly payment are due when the project starts, and monthly billing runs from that date rather than the launch date.

faqs.q: What if I cancel a rental early?
faqs.a: Website Rental has a minimum of 24 monthly payments. If you cancel before the end of that initial term, the remaining payments for the term are still due.

faqs.q: What happens after 24 months of renting?
faqs.a: You choose: keep renting at £75/month with 30 days’ notice to cancel; buy the website for £495 and keep our hosting and care at £25/month; or buy it for £495 and move it elsewhere. The price doesn’t drop to £25/month unless you buy the website. If the rental ends without a purchase, the website and its hosting end.

faqs.q: Can I move my website to another host?
faqs.a: Yes, once you own it. Buying a rented website for £495 includes a standard backup/export of the WordPress site. Moving it to the new host for you is quoted separately. Premium themes or plugins licensed through our agency account may need replacement licences elsewhere.
Hosting and care covers technical maintenance. Content changes are £60/hour, billed in 15-minute blocks. You can also make supported edits yourself using the handover guidance.
We can tidy and organise existing or supplied words. Full copywriting and case study writing are quoted separately.

We aim to launch your website within a week of receiving all required content and access. Delays in supplying content, access or approvals may move your launch date. Monthly billing continues from the agreed project start date.
We use AI to speed up design and build, but every site is designed, checked and tested by our team.
Yes. We’re part of MJS Media, a video production company, so homepage and explainer videos are a natural add-on.
